_about: Connectors approved per agent. Agents list them with capabilities_list and decide whether a step needs one. APIs are called only through api_call (allowlisted base URL and methods; credentials added by the server, never shown to the agent; every response saved and citable). MCP servers load into the agent's session when enabled. A person approves changes here; agents ask through capability_request.

osv.purpose: Known vulnerabilities for a dependency version (POST /v1/query with {"package":{"name":...,"ecosystem":"PyPI|npm"},"version":...})

pypi.purpose: Python package metadata: latest version, licence, release dates (GET /pypi/<package>/json)

github.purpose: GitHub REST API for the Hobasa repositories: issues, pull requests, checks (GET /repos/<owner>/<repo>/...)

playwright.purpose: Drive a browser for UI acceptance tests and screenshots
playwright.note: pin an exact package version before enabling

sonarqube.purpose: Static analysis results for a pull request
sonarqube.note: connect when SonarQube is licensed (C-items in the plan)

codegraph.purpose: Code intelligence over the repository: a symbol's source, its callers and callees, the blast radius of a change and the tests it affects (codegraph_explore, codegraph_node and related tools; pass projectPath = the repository checkout)
